term: adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno tassā vedanāya samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṁ na pajānāti
preferred_translation: when neutral feeling touches them, they do not discern that feeling's arising and vanishing, gratification, danger, and escape as they have come to be
alternative_translations: when neutral feeling touches them, they does not clearly know that feeling's arising and vanishing, gratification, danger, and escape as they have come to be
discouraged_translations: one treats the neutral register as objective neutrality
definition: MN 148's untrained neutral-feeling response that leaves the ignorance tendency in place.
notes: Use this record for the untrained neutral-feeling response in MN 148. Name the register neutral feeling, and keep the five-part discernment structure explicit even in the negated form.

example_phrases.pali: adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno tassā vedanāya samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṁ na pajānāti
example_phrases.translation: when neutral feeling touches them, they do not discern that feeling's arising and vanishing, gratification, danger, and escape as they have come to be

authority_basis.scope: Supports the neutral-feeling non-discernment line that leaves the ignorance tendency in place.

translation_policy.default_scope: Use this as the standard English control line for the untrained neutral-feeling response in MN 148.
translation_policy.when_not_to_apply: Do not flatten the line into generic misunderstanding language.
translation_policy.drift_risk: Prevents the neutral-feeling response from drifting into neutrality wording or losing the five-part discernment structure.
